title: Matt Harkenrider sets the mood with a groovy escape “By the Shoreline”
htmlContent: Matt Harkenrider’s song, By the Shoreline, combines lively dance music, smooth R&B, and funky vibes that make you want to get lost in its rhythm. The song draws you in with its catchy groove, featuring silky vocals layered over a fun, upbeat sound. The music flows in waves, sometimes calm and soothing and other times bursting with energy, just like the songs that inspired it. You can hear hints of Mariah Carey’s amazing singing and Janet Jackson’s cool style, but Matt adds his unique touch, which makes By the Shoreline truly special. https://open.spotify.com/track/2yMMGDB3ngmVjnw2Ofp5xc?si=WwaKmmtITFSzn541VtqhXg It’s mixing upbeat rhythms with a relaxed, soulful feel. By the Shoreline creates a fresh mood if you’re dancing under the stars or enjoying some quiet time with your headphones. Matt Harkenrider shows he knows how to create great music. The rich sounds and charm of By the Shoreline make it a song that moves you. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok
